_comment: Appeal windows in days from the date on the denial/remittance. VERIFY against each payer's provider manual and the plan type - these are defaults for triage, not legal advice. medicare_advantage overrides carrier default for MA plans (CMS rule).

UNITEDHEALTHCARE.notes: Shortest major-payer window. UHC commercial ~65 days; UHC MA plans 60 (CMS).

OPTUM.notes: Behavioral carve-out of UHC; confirm plan-level rules.

BCBS.notes: Varies by state Blue - 90 to 180. Confirm the specific plan.
